subject: english
title: Intermediate Examination 2025 English (Set H) - Section A

questions.question: Madhav is good ________ English. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: The standard phrase is 'good at' a subject or skill ('good at English').

questions.question: The ________ behaved in a ________ manner. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Friendly' is a standard manner adjective in the available options.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence:
options: Sangita is far beautiful than her friend.
Sangita is far more beautiful than her friend.
Sangita is far most beautiful than her friend.
Sangita is far the most beautiful than her friend.
questions.explanation: Comparative degree uses 'more beautiful than', and 'far' can intensify a comparative ('far more beautiful than').

questions.question: A lot of energy ________ wasted on finding the dog. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Energy' is an uncountable noun, so singular verb 'was' is used in passive past.

questions.question: The work was done ________ haste. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'In haste' is the fixed prepositional phrase meaning hurriedly.

questions.question: Choose the correct spelling:
questions.explanation: 'Harmony' is the correct spelling.

questions.question: ________ before you leap. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: The proverb 'Look before you leap' begins with the imperative base verb 'Look'.

questions.question: It remains a ________ open question. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: Adverb 'completely' modifies the adjective 'open' ('completely open question').

questions.question: ________ rose has a thorn. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Every' applies universally to each member of a group ('Every rose has a thorn.').

questions.question: ________ doesn't know you? (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: Subject pronoun 'Who' asks about a person ('Who doesn't know you?').

questions.question: He ________ of the deal at the last moment. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Backed out' means withdrew from an agreement or commitment.

questions.question: February has ________ days than March. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Fewer' is used with plural countable nouns ('days') before 'than'.

questions.question: Take an umbrella in case it ________. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: Simple present 'rains' follows 'in case' for a future possibility.

questions.question: We ________ keep our colonies clean. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Should' expresses moral duty or civic responsibility.

questions.question: Rani is ill. She is working hard. (Choose the correct option)
options: Rani is ill and working hard.
Rani is ill yet she is working hard.
Ill is Rani but working hard.
Working hard is Rani and she is ill.
questions.explanation: 'Yet' contrasts her illness with her continued hard work.

questions.question: Choose the correctly spelt word:
questions.explanation: 'Transformation' is the correct spelling.

questions.question: Suraj drives the truck. (Choose the correct passive sentence)
options: The truck is driven by Suraj.
The truck will be driven by Suraj.
The truck was driven by Suraj.
The truck may be driven by Suraj.
questions.explanation: Simple present active ('drives') becomes simple present passive ('is driven by Suraj.').

questions.question: Ram must have seen the Taj Mahal. (Choose the correct negative sentence)
options: Ram must not have missed to see the Taj Mahal.
Ram must not have seen the Taj Mahal.
Ram did not see the Taj Mahal.
The Taj Mahal was seen by Ram.
questions.explanation: 'Ram must not have seen the Taj Mahal.' negates the modal deduction directly.

questions.question: The antonym of 'Clever' is ________. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Stupid' is the opposite of 'clever' in general usage.

questions.question: The synonym of 'Worried' is ________. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Troubled' means anxious or worried.

questions.question: The antonym of 'Clean' is ________. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Dirty' is the opposite of 'clean'.

questions.question: The synonym of 'Lofty' is ________. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Lofty' means tall, elevated, or high.

questions.question: The antonym of 'Finish' is ________. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Start' is the opposite of 'finish'.

questions.question: The thief was beaten ________. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Beaten black and blue' is a standard idiom meaning severely bruised/beaten.

questions.question: They went to the beach ________ a picnic. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'For a picnic' expresses purpose.

questions.question: She enjoys ________ poetry in her free time. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Enjoy' is followed by a gerund ('reading').

questions.question: Sonam said, "What a beautiful park!" (Choose the correct indirect speech)
options: Sonam thought that it was a beautiful park.
Sonam said that it was a beautiful park.
Sonam exclaimed with joy that it was a beautiful park.
Sonam was happy to see a beautiful park.
questions.explanation: Exclamatory praise in past tense converts to 'exclaimed with joy that it was a beautiful park'.

questions.question: We eat so that we ________ survive. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'So that + we may + V1' expresses purpose in present time.

questions.question: By whom has the dog been killed? (Choose the correct active voice)
options: Who will be killing the dog?
Who had to kill the dog?
Who must have killed the dog?
questions.explanation: Present perfect passive 'By whom has ... been killed?' converts to active 'Who has killed the dog?'

questions.question: The train went by. It did not stop. (Choose the correct combination)
options: The train will go by and will not stop.
The train went by because it will not stop.
The train goes by therefore it did not stop.
The train went by without stopping.
questions.explanation: 'The train went by without stopping.' concisely combines both past actions.

questions.question: My children told me that they would love me ________. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Forever' fits the meaning of lasting affection.

questions.question: We can't expect any ________ help from them. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Further' means additional or more help.

questions.question: He looks ________ than he is. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: Comparative adjective 'older' is required before 'than'.

questions.question: Mix the powder with ________ water. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'A little' means a small amount of uncountable noun 'water'.

questions.question: Let everyone be given a chance. (Choose the correct active voice)
options: Let a chance be given to everyone.
I will give up a chance.
questions.explanation: Passive 'Let everyone be given a chance.' converts to imperative active 'Give everyone a chance.'

questions.question: She said, "How ugly I look in this dress!" (Choose the correct indirect narration)
options: She said that how ugly she was looking in that dress.
She exclaimed how ugly she looked in that dress.
She expressed how ugly she looked in that dress.
She exclaimed that she looked very ugly in that dress.
questions.explanation: 'She exclaimed that she looked very ugly in that dress.' properly shifts tense ('look' to 'looked'), pronoun ('I' to 'she'), and demonstrative ('this' to 'that').

questions.question: They can speak English, ________? (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: Positive statement with modal 'can' takes negative tag 'can't they'.

questions.question: Neither of them ________ going to attend the party. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Neither of them' takes a singular verb ('is') in formal/standard grammar.

questions.question: I bought ________ flowers for my mother. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: Plural demonstrative determiner 'these' modifies plural noun 'flowers'.

questions.question: The synonym of 'Dormant' is ________. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Dormant' means inactive or sleeping/resting.

questions.question: The antonym of 'Guilty' is ________. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Innocent' is the opposite of 'guilty'.

questions.question: "To shed crocodile tears" means ________. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'To shed crocodile tears' means to show insincere or pretended sorrow.

questions.question: Eggs are sold by ________ dozen. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'By the dozen' is the standard idiomatic expression for selling by unit/measure.

questions.question: The child ran ________ the road. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Ran across the road' means moved from one side of the road to the other.

questions.question: We ________ qualify this year. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'May' expresses possibility for the current year.

questions.question: Choose the correct spelling:
questions.explanation: 'Dissuade' is the correct spelling.

questions.question: I can't meet you tomorrow, ________ I have an appointment. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'For' here acts as a coordinating conjunction meaning 'because'.

questions.question: Virat Kohli ________ for India. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: Simple present 'plays' fits singular subject 'Virat Kohli'.

questions.question: He died ________ his society. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Died for' means gave one's life for a cause, people, or society.

questions.question: She is ________ most beautiful girl. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: Definite article 'the' precedes superlative 'most beautiful'.

questions.question: Milk and vegetables ________ good for health. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: Compound plural subject ('Milk and vegetables') takes plural verb 'are'.

questions.question: I'll call you ________ I arrive at the airport. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: Time conjunction 'when' introduces the arrival event.

questions.question: The sun is shining, it's a ________ day. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: Adjective 'beautiful' modifies the noun 'day'.

questions.question: ________ he studied hard, he failed. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Although' introduces a contrast between studying hard and failing.

questions.question: The stars ________ counted. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Cannot be counted' expresses impossibility in passive form.

questions.question: Dogs bark at night, ________? (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: Positive simple present statement with plural 'Dogs' takes negative tag 'don't they'.

questions.question: Are you ________? (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Married or single' is the standard marital status pair.

questions.question: Choose the correct spelling:
questions.explanation: 'Laborious' is the correct spelling.

questions.question: Please excuse me for ________. (Choose the correct answer)
questions.explanation: Preposition 'for' is followed by the gerund phrase 'being late'.

questions.question: The synonym of 'Division' is ________. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanation: 'Partition' is a synonym of 'division'.

questions.question: "The past is not dead and static, it is alive and dynamic" is said by:
questions.explanation: In 'Bharat is My Home', Dr. Zakir Hussain states that the past is alive and dynamic.

questions.question: Martin Luther King, Jr. dislikes ________ discrimination.
questions.explanation: In 'I Have a Dream', Martin Luther King, Jr. opposes racial discrimination.

questions.question: A ________ woman visits her mother's house for the last few months of her pregnancy.
questions.explanation: In Germaine Greer's 'A Child is Born', a Sylheti woman goes to her mother's house for the last months of pregnancy.

questions.question: Benjy's parents are known as the ________.
questions.explanation: In H. E. Bates's 'The Earth', Benjy's parents are the Johnsons.

questions.question: Nanukaka had tied a huge ________ round the narrator's head.
questions.explanation: In 'A Pinch of Snuff', Nanukaka tied a huge orange turban around the narrator's head.

questions.question: What did Seibei apply to get rid of the unpleasant gourd smell?
questions.explanation: In Shiga Naoya's 'The Artist', Seibei used tea-leaves to remove the unpleasant smell from gourds.

questions.question: Natalya and ________ are quarrelling for Ox Meadows.
questions.explanation: In Anton Chekhov's 'A Marriage Proposal', Natalya and Lomov argue over Ox Meadows.

questions.question: According to Pearl S. Buck, the main quality of a leader should be ________.
questions.explanation: Pearl S. Buck emphasizes selflessness as a vital quality of leadership.

questions.question: 'And the nightingale is dumb' is from:
options: Now the Leaves are Falling Fast
questions.explanation: This line appears in W. H. Auden's 'Now the Leaves are Falling Fast'.

questions.question: John Keats is from ________.
questions.explanation: John Keats was an English Romantic poet from Britain.

questions.question: Walter de la Mare knew a ________ who is dead now.
questions.explanation: In 'An Epitaph', the poet recalls a lady who was most beautiful and is now dead.

questions.question: Rupert Brooke's reputation as a poet rests on ________ sonnets.
questions.explanation: Rupert Brooke became famous especially for his five '1914' war sonnets.

questions.question: About ________ years ago, Latin was a world language.
questions.explanation: In the Bihar Board History of English textbook, Latin is noted as a world language around 800 years ago.

questions.question: Who wrote "Leaves of Grass"?
questions.explanation: 'Leaves of Grass' is Walt Whitman's famous poetry collection.

questions.question: ________ is dead against blind imitation of western civilization.
questions.explanation: In 'Indian Civilization and Culture', Mahatma Gandhi strongly opposes blind imitation of Western civilization.

questions.question: Who refuses to believe that the bank of justice is bankrupt?
questions.explanation: In 'I Have a Dream', Martin Luther King, Jr. speaks of the Negroes refusing to believe the bank of justice is bankrupt.

questions.question: Who was the great dramatist of the Elizabethan Age?
questions.explanation: William Shakespeare is the foremost dramatist of the Elizabethan Age.

questions.question: In UK, Australia and New Zealand, English is spoken as a ________.
questions.explanation: English is a native/first language in the UK, Australia, and New Zealand.

questions.question: English developed from the speech of ________.
questions.explanation: English evolved from the Germanic speech of the Anglo-Saxons.

questions.question: Who wrote "The Cherry Orchard"?
questions.explanation: 'The Cherry Orchard' is a well-known play by Anton Chekhov.

questions.question: 'The Artist' is ________.
questions.explanation: 'The Artist' by Shiga Naoya is a short story.

questions.question: Anton Chekhov began his career by writing ________.
questions.explanation: Anton Chekhov began his writing career with humorous/comic sketches.

questions.question: John Donne is a ________ poet.
questions.explanation: John Donne is celebrated as a leading metaphysical poet.

questions.question: Walt Whitman was a ________ during the Civil War.
questions.explanation: Walt Whitman served as a volunteer nurse tending wounded soldiers during the American Civil War.

questions.question: Benjy left school at the age of ________.
questions.explanation: In H. E. Bates's 'The Earth', Benjy left school at fourteen.

questions.question: The line "O how feeble is man's power" occurs in the poem:
options: Sweetest Love I Do Not Goe
questions.explanation: This line is from John Donne's poem 'Sweetest Love, I Do Not Goe'.

questions.question: The line "And gathering swallows twitter in the skies" is from:
questions.explanation: This closing imagery appears in John Keats's 'Ode to Autumn'.

questions.question: It was said that the sun never sets in the ________ Empire.
questions.explanation: The phrase 'the empire on which the sun never sets' was used for the British Empire.

questions.question: Dorothy L. Sayers was one of the first women to graduate from Oxford University in ________.
questions.explanation: Dorothy L. Sayers was among the early women graduates at Oxford (1915).

questions.question: ________ is a 'window to the world'.
questions.explanation: English is widely described as a 'window to the world' for global knowledge and communication.

questions.question: Who wrote 'Piers the Plowman'?
questions.explanation: 'Piers Plowman' is a Middle English allegorical poem attributed to William Langland.

questions.question: ________ has the largest number of native speakers.
questions.explanation: Chinese (Mandarin) has the largest number of native speakers.

questions.question: ________ prefers spiritualism to materialism.
questions.explanation: Mahatma Gandhi emphasizes spiritualism over mere materialism in 'Indian Civilization and Culture'.

questions.question: Nanukaka still wore ________.
questions.explanation: In 'A Pinch of Snuff', Nanukaka wore a knee-length black coat and turban.

questions.question: The English government give elderly people a/an ________.
questions.explanation: In 'How Free is the Press', a pension for elderly people is mentioned.

questions.question: Dorothy L. Sayers published an authentic verse translation of ________.
questions.explanation: Dorothy L. Sayers translated Dante's 'Inferno' into verse.

questions.question: "He's broken every human law" is from:
questions.explanation: This line describes Macavity in T. S. Eliot's 'Macavity: The Mystery Cat'.

questions.question: ________ swears to save fire from the sin of forgiving.
questions.explanation: In 'Fire-Hymn', Keki N. Daruwalla vows/swears to save fire from the sin of forgetfulness/forgiving.

questions.question: The snake drank enough and lifted his head, '________'.
questions.explanation: In D. H. Lawrence's 'Snake', after drinking enough, the snake lifted his head dreamily.

questions.question: Kamala Das remembers the happy days spent in the sweet company of her ________.
questions.explanation: In 'My Grandmother's House', Kamala Das fondly remembers happy days spent with her grandmother.
